text: My day starts at six-thirty with a glass of water and a short stretching routine. After a quick shower and breakfast, I’m at my desk by eight. My work schedule is fairly steady—I’m a graphic designer, so I spend most mornings on client projects and emails. I take a real lunch break, then have a quick afternoon walk to clear my head. After work, I either go for a thirty-minute run or do yoga at home. Evenings are for cooking dinner and reading or catching up with friends online. By eleven, I’m in bed, ready to do it all again. Consistency keeps me feeling balanced and productive.
